title: Integral and fractional expectation thresholds are equivalent
summary: We prove Talagrand's conjecture that integral and fractional expectation thresholds are within a universal constant factor, with the same covering budget.
family_title: Talagrand’s expectation thresholds, discrete convexity, and graph decompositions

review.reason: Proves that integral and fractional expectation thresholds are equivalent up to a constant factor.
